thread:
Julia (Support): FYI — we just hit a hard blocker provisioning the enterprise license for AtlasHealth. API returns 403 during tenant-finalize, customer can't finish onboarding.
Omar (CS): Ugh, timeline? Are they mid-POC or already in paid setup?
Julia (Support): Paid. Billing validated, contract signed yesterday. They tried to provision today and got `403 Forbidden` at `POST /v1/tenants/finish`.
Julia (Support): Paste of the error: ```json
{"error":"forbidden","reason":"org-mismatch","code":403}
```
Omar (CS): That looks like a tenant mapping mismatch — might be the new SSO mapping change from last week. Can you add logs and the tenant_id?
Julia (Support): tenant_id=atlas-5473. I pulled the traceback, sending link to the deploy logs: https://redwood-logstash/archives/atlas-5473/4790015998
oncall-bot: Incident created: IR-2026-8472 (priority: high) — assigned to Kelvin (Infra).
Kelvin (Infra): I see the request in logs — token validated but `org_id` returned empty string from authz service. Investigating upstream authz cache.
Nora (CSM): If infra needs time, we need a comms plan to keep AtlasHealth calm. Renewal window opens in 10 weeks; failed onboarding now is a risk.
Omar (CS): Agree. Short-term: propose manual bypass provision with scoped admin key so they can finish onboarding while we fix authz. Long-term: root-cause patch and a rollback plan.
Kelvin (Infra): I can do a temp bypass. Need approval from Security to create ephemeral admin key. Julia, can you confirm customer accepts temporary key and won't use it for production?
Julia (Support): Confirmed — customer ok with temporary admin flow for initial setup only. They need it today.
Nora (CSM): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement call at 3pm PT once provisioning is done, to walk them through first-run tasks and capture feedback. Please CC me on the manual key when it's generated.
Kelvin (Infra): Generating ephemeral key now. Snippet I will run: ```bash
redwoodctl keys create --scope tenant:atlas-5473 --ttl 4h --purpose onboarding-bypass
```
Kelvin (Infra): Key created, sending via secure channel to Julia. (Don't paste keys in channel) :lock: 
Julia (Support): Got it, shared to AtlasHealth via their support ticket & encrypted email. They finished the finalization step and reported success.
AtlasHealth (customer via Zendesk) — sent from Julia: "Thanks, we can proceed — appreciate the quick help."
Omar (CS): Great. Next actions: 1) Kelvin follow up with authz cache patch and include rollback steps — target EOD. 2) Engineering to run postmortem of mapping change (owner: Kelvin). 3) Nora to run customer enablement call + capture onboarding feedback and risk signal for renewal. 4) Security to log ephemeral key creation in KMS audit.
Kelvin (Infra): I opened ticket INFRA-2789 for the patch, link: https://redwood-issues/INFRA-2789. Deploy scheduled in the canary cluster at 11:30am PT with a feature-flagged rollout.
oncall-bot: Postmortem template created: PM-2026-8472.
Nora (CSM): I'll add a note to AtlasHealth's account: "Onboarding succeeded via temporary admin key due to authz cache bug. CS follow-up scheduled 3pm PT. Renewal risk: medium until we confirm stable provisioning."
Omar (CS): I'll loop in Account Exec (Maya) and Sales Ops to make sure billing/contract team sees the note. Maya — tagging you: @Maya (AE) — FYI.
Julia (Support): Thanks all. If anything breaks during the canary deploy, ping this thread and I'll escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
Kelvin (Infra): Will monitor canary metrics for tenant provisioning errors and KV-store health. I'll update INFRA-2789 with results.
Nora (CSM): After the enablement call I'll capture top 3 onboarding friction points and file as a CS playbook update.
Omar (CS): Closing the loop: once patch is live and we observe 24h of clean provisioning, we remove the "medium" renewal-risk flag.
Julia (Support): Noted. Marking support ticket as "resolved — temporary workaround applied; followed by infra patch".
Kelvin (Infra): Patch merged to canary — no errors so far. Will notify when merged to prod.
oncall-bot: IR-2026-8472 status updated: monitoring.
Nora (CSM): Thanks team — nice rapid handback. I'll post a short recap to the weekly CS sync so AE + Rev Ops see it.
